name: jire-brand-video
description: Brand Builders 60s + 15s animated UI video (Remotion), beat-locked at 120 BPM

scripts.studio: npm run music && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render:60: npm run music && remotion render src/index.ts BrandBuilders60 out/jire-brand-builders-60s.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/jire-brand-builders-60s.mp4 -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/jire-brand-builders-60s-sound.mp4
scripts.render:15: npm run music && remotion render src/index.ts BrandBuilders15 out/jire-brand-builders-15s.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/jire-brand-builders-15s.mp4 -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/jire-brand-builders-15s-sound.mp4
